mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increasing the present value of future earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5 (using a rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises and the federal funds rate remains elevated, the economy faces stagflationary pressures that reduce corporate profit margins and investor risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE rising and FEDFUNDS above 5.0% does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (using a rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts signals a weakening demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in HOUST does not lead to negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (using a rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 (using a rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of monthly job growth, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (using a rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recoveries, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle recoveries, a rise in INDPRO does not lead to positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (using a rolling 3-year window).
